manifest:
[package]
name="combined-proof"
version="0.0.0"
edition="2021"
[dependencies]
baseline={package="meshoptimizer-baseline",path="<target>/base",default-features=false,features=["std", "simd", "parallel", "clusterlod", "experimental", "parity-internals"]}
candidate={package="meshoptimizer-rs",path="<worktree>",default-features=false,features=["std", "simd", "parallel", "clusterlod", "experimental", "parity-internals"]}
rayon="=1.11.0"
[[bin]]
name="par-spec"
path="<target>/par-spec.rs"
[profile.release]
lto="thin"
codegen-units=1
debug-assertions=true
overflow-checks=true
